name: Shrimad Ramayan
description: 'Shrimad Ramayan' brings to life the timeless Hindu epic, the Ramayana, with a deep commitment to authenticity, cultural reverence and contemporary sensibility. The epic narrative of the Ramayana is rooted in the two words, 'Ram' and 'Ayana.' 'Ram' represents the human incarnation of Lord Vishnu, while 'Ayana' signifies a journey. Thus, the Ramayana unfolds through the voyage of Ram, a mortal who ascended to become Purushottam, the paragon among men, transcending his own inherent limitations.

videos.title: Shri Ram Ki Katha
videos.overview: Dasharatha prays to the gods to bless him with a son and an heir. His friend, Jatayu, asks for his help to fight a war and save the Devatas. Will he agree to help him?

videos.title: Tapasya Ka Vardaan
videos.overview: Dasharatha accidentally kills Shravan Kumar during a hunting expedition and gets cursed by his parents. Meanwhile, Ravan prays to Lord Brahma and asks to grant him immortality so that he can defeat Kuber and take over Lanka.

videos.title: Putrakameshti Yagya
videos.overview: King Dasharatha performs a Yagya in the hope of being blessed with a son. Meanwhile, Ravan challenges Lord Shiva and is punished for his arrogance.

videos.title: Punya Ka Fal
videos.overview: Shri Ram is born and brings joy to Ayodhya. Lord Vishnu reveals details to Kausalya about her past life. King Janak finds Mata Sita while ploughing the fields in Mithila. Later, Dasharatha agrees to send his sons to the Gurukul.

videos.title: Prakash Aur Andhkar
videos.overview: Shri Ram and his brothers gain valuable knowledge and experience at the Gurukul. Mata Sita engages in an intellectual debate with Devi Gargi. Meanwhile, Ravan and Kumbhkarna disrupt Yagyas across the land.

videos.title: Dharam Ka Suraj
videos.overview: Ayodhya's princes grow up in the Gurukul and return home after gaining knowledge. The kingdom erupts in joy at their arrival. Meanwhile, Mata Sita talks to Devi Gargi about her marriage.

videos.title: Ayodhya Ka Tej
videos.overview: Kaikeyi advises Dasharath to send Bharat away for royal tutelage. Bharat is disappointed, but Shri Ram explains the importance of the decision. Later, Maharishi Vishwamitra comes to Ayodhya and makes a troubling request.

videos.title: Maharishi Vishwamitra Ki Pariksha
videos.overview: Shri Ram and Lakshman join Maharishi Vishwamitra on a journey through the forest. Maharishi Vishwamitra teaches them valuable lessons. Meanwhile, Ravan marries Mandodari and subdues all the planetary deities with his might.

videos.title: Tataka Vadh
videos.overview: Shri Ram and Lakshman are confronted by the demoness Tataka. Maharishi Vishwamitra tells Shri Ram about Tataka's past. Shri Ram finally ends Tataka and grants her Moksha.

videos.title: Karuna Ka Baan
videos.overview: Shri Ram and Lakshman protect Maharishi Vishwamitra's Yagya from Subahu and Maricha. Shri Ram receives powerful Divya Astras from Maharishi Vishwamitra. Later, news of Shri Ram's heroic deeds reaches Mata Sita and the people of Mithila.

videos.title: Shri Ram Naam Ka Mol
videos.overview: Shri Ram frees Ahalya from the curse bestowed upon her by her husband, Maharishi Gautam. Meanwhile, Ravan arrives in Mithila for Mata Sita's Swayamvar.

videos.title: Charitra Bal
videos.overview: Shri Ram diverts the direction of the river to save the village from being destroyed. Ravan fails to lift Lord Shiva's Pinaka bow at the Swayamvar. Later, Shri Ram arrives in the kingdom of Mithila.

videos.title: Swayamvar Ka Nimantran
videos.overview: Shri Ram arrives in Mithila and meets Mata Sita. King Janak invites Shri Ram to the Swayamvar, and Lakshman convinces Maharishi Vishwamitra to let Shri Ram attend the Swayamvar.

videos.title: Mata Sita Ka Swayamvar
videos.overview: Mata Sita and Shri Ram meet once again in a temple. Kings and princes from across the land arrive in Mithila, but none of them succeed in lifting Lord Shiva's bow. Later, Maharishi Vishwamitra allows Shri Ram to attend the Swayamvar.

videos.title: Mahadev Ki Ichcha
videos.overview: King Janak is worried as no one is able to lift Lord Shiva's bow. Shri Ram lifts it with ease, but it breaks when he tries to string it. Lord Parashurama gets angry after Lord Shiva's bow is destroyed.

videos.title: Shri Ram Ki Yogyata
videos.overview: Lakshman defends Shri Ram against Lord Parashurama. Shri Ram lifts Lord Vishnu's Sharanga bow to prove himself. Lord Parashurama apologizes for misjudging him. Later, King Janak invites Dasharatha for Shri Ram and Mata Sita's marriage.

videos.title: Vivaah Ka Shubh Avsar
videos.overview: Shri Ram entrusts Lord Vishnu's bow to Varun Dev for safekeeping. Later, Bharat and Shatrughna arrive in Mithila for the wedding.

videos.title: Ek Sundar Sanjog
videos.overview: Lord Shiva, Devi Parvati, and the other deities decide to attend Shri Ram and Mata Sita's wedding. Meanwhile, Dasharatha discusses the marriage of his three sons with King Janak's three daughters.

videos.title: Janmo Ka Saath
videos.overview: Lord Shiva advises that the marriage of all four princes should be kept on the same day. King Janak is upset about being separated from his daughters after marriage. Later, Shri Ram and Mata Sita perform a ritual together.

videos.title: Pavitra Sambandh
videos.overview: Shri Ram and Mata Sita set up the Mandap for their wedding together. Later, Lord Ganesh arrives to bless Shri Ram and Mata Sita himself.

videos.title: Shri Ram Ki Var Yatra
videos.overview: Lord Shiva offers Shri Ram the option of taking Sanyas, but Shri Ram declines the offer and impresses Lord Shiva with his commitment to his family. Later, Shri Ram and Mata Sita get ready for their marriage.

videos.title: Shri Ram Aur Mata Sita Ka Shubh Vivaah
videos.overview: Shri Ram and Mata Sita arrive for their wedding rituals. King Janak performs Mata Sita's 'kanyadaan'. Later, Shri Ram and Mata Sita take their 'saat phere' together.

videos.title: Mata Sita Ki Vidai
videos.overview: Shri Ram and Mata Sita take blessings from their parents after their marriage. Mata Sita and her family members get emotional during her Vidai. Meanwhile, Kaikeyi finds out about her son Bharat's marriage.

videos.title: Mata Sita Ka Griha Pravesh
videos.overview: Shri Ram, Mata Sita and the others return to Ayodhya after their marriage. Later, Mata Sita completes her Griha Pravesh and performs the ring-finding ritual with Shri Ram.

videos.title: Santan Ka Prem
videos.overview: Kaikeyi asks Sumitra to make an offering to Shri Ram and Mata Sita. Meanwhile, Manthara instigates Kaikeyi against Shri Ram and asks her to take a stand for her own sons.

videos.title: Ayodhya Ka Bhavishya
videos.overview: Bharat and Shatrughna return to Kekeya after their marriage. Dasharatha decides to name Shri Ram as the next king of Ayodhya. Meanwhile, Manthara tries to turn Kaikeyi against Shri Ram.

videos.title: Dasharatha Ke Do Vachan
videos.overview: Mata Sita finds out that Shri Ram has been named the next king of Ayodhya. Meanwhile, Kaikeyi wants to meet Dasharatha in person to redeem her two wishes.

videos.title: Maryada Ka Mukut
videos.overview: Dasharatha is deeply wounded after listening to Kaikeyi's demands. Shri Ram gets the news that Dasharatha is unwell, and he leaves his coronation ceremony to meet him. Later, Kaikeyi tells Shri Ram about her demands.

videos.title: Raghukul Ki Reet
videos.overview: Shri Ram happily accepts the two demands made by Kaikeyi. Later, Shri Ram tells Mata Sita and Kausalya that he has given up the throne of Ayodhya in favour of Bharat.

videos.title: Niyati Ka Khel
videos.overview: Mata Sita wants to accompany Shri Ram to the fourteen-year-long Vanvas. Lakshman is enraged when he finds out about Kaikeyi's demands and seeks retribution against Kaikeyi and Dasharatha.

videos.title: Shri Ram Ka Tyaag
videos.overview: Lakshman asks to accompany Shri Ram for Vanvas. Shri Ram asks Lakshman to seek permission from his wife, Urmila. Meanwhile, Kaikeyi asks Shri Ram to don bhagwa clothing before leaving Ayodhya.

videos.title: Dharam Ki Yatra
videos.overview: Shri Ram, Lakshman, and Mata Sita leave all their royal possessions behind and don their 'bhagwa' clothing. Meanwhile, the people of Ayodhya protest against Shri Ram's Vanvas and try to stop him from leaving.

videos.title: Praja Ki Vinati
videos.overview: The citizens of Ayodhya are not willing to let Shri Ram leave them. Meanwhile, Ravan decides to take revenge against Vidyutjiva along with his son, Meghanada.

videos.title: Ayodhya Ka Prem
videos.overview: The citizens of Ayodhya stop Shri Ram's chariot and insist on accompanying Shri Ram for the Vanvas. Meanwhile, Ravan instructs Meghanada to accompany him to Pataal Lok.

videos.title: Kartavya Nishtha
videos.overview: Shri Ram is greeted by Nishadraj Guha, the king of the tribals, on the banks of the river Ganga. Meanwhile, Ravan and Meghanada take Sulochana's help to enter Pataal Lok, but Varun Dev stands in their way.

videos.title: Asha Ka Beej
videos.overview: Kevat asks permission to touch Shri Ram's feet in exchange for ferrying him across the Ganga River. Meanwhile, Ravan enters Pataal Lok and attacks Vidyutjiva.

videos.title: Dasharatha Ka Gaurav
videos.overview: Ravan and Meghanada defeat Vidyutjiva together. Ravan decides to steal Naagmani from Naag Lok. Meanwhile, Sumantra returns to Ayodhya and conveys to Dasharatha that Shri Ram refused to return along with him.

videos.title: Sansarik Neeti
videos.overview: Dasharatha passes away after not being able to bear the pain of separating from Shri Ram. Meanwhile, Shri Ram and Lakshman protect a group of Rishis from the Asuras who were attacking them.

videos.title: Ayodhya Ka Ansh
videos.overview: Bharat and Shatrughna are recalled to Ayodhya after Dasharatha's passing. Meanwhile, Lakshman builds a hut for Shri Ram and Mata Sita when they reach Chitrakoot.

videos.title: Dharam Ki Paribhasha
videos.overview: Bharat finds out that Kaikeyi was the one who forced Shri Ram to accept the Vanvas and got Dasharatha to name him as the next king. Bharat is enraged with Kaikeyi and decides to renounce her.

videos.title: Ek Naye Yug Ka Arambh
videos.overview: Bharat and Shatrughna perform Dasharatha's last rites in Ayodhya. Later, Bharat prepares to leave and bring Shri Ram back from his Vanvas. Meanwhile, a group of Rishis arrive in Chitrakoot to meet Shri Ram.

videos.title: Bharat Ki Vinati
videos.overview: A group of Rishis ask for Shri Ram's help in stopping the Asuras tormenting them. Ravan returns to Lanka after defeating Vidyutjiva. Meanwhile, Nishadraj Guha stops Bharat who is on his way to meet Shri Ram.

videos.title: Stree Ki Garima
videos.overview: Indra's son Jayanta feels mesmerised by Mata Sita, and he takes on the form of a crow to approach her. Meanwhile, Nishadraj Guha apologises to Bharat for misunderstanding him and agrees to take him to Chitrakoot.

videos.title: Prem Aur Samarpan
videos.overview: On reaching Chitrakoot, Bharat has an emotional reunion with Shri Ram, who then fulfils his duty as Dasharath's eldest son. Later, King Janak arrives in Chitrakoot and asks Mata Sita to return to Ayodhya.

videos.title: Chitrakoot Ki Sabha
videos.overview: Bharat asks Shri Ram to return to Ayodhya and take his rightful place as king. However, Shri Ram is not willing to dishonour Dasharatha and his words by returning home. Later, King Janak holds a public discussion where Shri Ram and Bharat debate their sides.

videos.title: Shri Ram Ke Param Bhakt
videos.overview: Shri Ram agrees to ascend the throne of Ayodhya, but only after completing fourteen years of Vanvas. Bharat agrees to his conditions and takes his Padukas as his blessings. Meanwhile, Lord Hanuman builds a stone idol of Shri Ram.

videos.title: Bhakti Aur Shakti Ka Sangam
videos.overview: Lord Hanuman defends young Vanars from the tiger attacking them. Meanwhile, Shri Ram leaves to provide aid to the Rishis who sought his help.

videos.title: Dandakaranya Ka Asura
videos.overview: Upon reaching Dandakaranya, Shri Ram and Lakshman encounter an Asura named Viradha. Will Shri Ram and Lakshman be able to defeat him?

videos.title: Shri Ram Ka Margdarshan
videos.overview: The reign of the Vanar King Sugriva comes under threat when his older brother, Vali, returns. Meanwhile, Shri Ram arrives to meet Rishi Sarabhanga, who guides him onto the next stage of his journey.

videos.title: Vali Ki Chunauti
videos.overview: Vali blames Sugriva for conspiring against him and stealing his throne. Lord Hanuman speaks up against Vali and defends Sugriva. Meanwhile, Shurpanakha arrives in Dandakaranya and meets her brothers, Khar and Dushan.

videos.title: Dharam Aur Balidaan
videos.overview: Vali throws Sugriva out of Kishkindha and forces him to flee. Khar and Dushan get information about Shri Ram's presence in Dandakaranya. Meanwhile, Sugriva seeks refuge in the Rishyamukha mountain.

videos.title: Varshon Ki Pratiksha
videos.overview: Lord Hanuman convinces Vali to leave Sugriva alone until he remains in Rishyamukha. Meanwhile, Shri Ram finally meets Rishi Agastya after spending several years searching for him.

videos.title: Shambuka Ka Hamla
videos.overview: Rishi Agastya grants powerful weapons to Shri Ram and Lakshman and guides them towards Panchvati. Meanwhile, Shurpanakha's son, Shambuka, takes his army and mounts an attack against Shri Ram.

videos.title: Shurpanakha Ka Prastaav
videos.overview: Shambuka enters Panchvati, stalking Mata Sita. Lakshman finds Shambuka and ends his life swiftly. Meanwhile, Shurpanakha goes out to look for her son and comes across Shri Ram's residence.

videos.title: Shurpanakha Ka Pratishod
videos.overview: Lakshman cuts off Shurpanakha's nose when she tries to attack Mata Sita. Shurpanakha finds out that her son Shambuka has been killed. Later, Shurpanakha returns to Dandakaranya and tells Khar and Dushan about what happened.

videos.title: Panchvati Ki Suraksha
videos.overview: Khar and Dushan march towards Panchvati along with their army to take revenge for Shurpanakha. Shri Ram faces them all by himself and defeats them one by one.

videos.title: Ravan Ka Krodh
videos.overview: Shurpanakha tells Ravan about what happened to her and wants Ravan to take revenge against Shri Ram on her behalf. Meanwhile, Shri Ram tries to cheer up Mata Sita after the battle in Panchvati.

videos.title: Ravan Ka Pratishod
videos.overview: Ravan is determined to take revenge against Shri Ram and Lakshman for their actions against his sister Shurpanakha. Later, he meets Maricha and demands his support against Shri Ram.

videos.title: Lakshman Rekha
videos.overview: Shri Ram promises Mata Sita that he will capture the golden deer and bring it back to her. Meanwhile, he instructs Lakshman to keep watch over Mata Sita and ensure her safety. However, Lakshman hears cries for help and creates a 'Lakshman Rekha' around Mata Sita's cottage, warning her to stay within it at all times in their absence.

videos.title: Mata Sita Ka Haran
videos.overview: Mata Sita is forced to cross the Lakshman Rekha as she doesn't want to offend the Rishi. Ravan reveals his true self in front of Mata Sita and kidnaps her. Shri Ram senses that Mata Sita might be in trouble and rushes back to Panchvati.

videos.title: Jatayu Ka Vachan
videos.overview: While searching for Mata Sita, Shri Ram and Lakshman follow the trail she left for them. Meanwhile, Jatayu tries to stop Ravan and save Mata Sita from him.

videos.title: Jatayu Ka Balidaan
videos.overview: Ravan defeats Jatayu after learning his weakness. Shri Ram comes across an injured Jatayu and finds out that Ravan was the one who took away Mata Sita.

videos.title: Lankesh Ki Taakat
videos.overview: Ravan brings Mata Sita to Lanka and gives her a demonstration of his power. Meanwhile, Shri Ram and Lakshman are confronted by an Asura during their search for Mata Sita.

videos.title: Vinaash Ka Beej
videos.overview: Shri Ram travels to Mata Shabari's ashram to seek her guidance in finding Mata Sita. Meanwhile, Vibhishana opposes Ravan and urges him to return Mata Sita to Shri Ram.

videos.title: Bhakti Ka Rang
videos.overview: Shri Ram and Lakshman arrive at Mata Shabri's ashram. Meanwhile, Ravan gets ready for his wedding, but Mata Sita is not willing to accept his demands.

videos.title: Ravan Ka Prastaav
videos.overview: Ravan goes to Ashok Vatika to convince Mata Sita to marry him. Meanwhile, Mata Shabri asks Shri Ram to seek Sugriva's help to find Ravan.

videos.title: Bhakti Ki Pariksha
videos.overview: Shri Ram and Lakshman make their way to the Rishyamukha mountain. Sugriva thinks that Shri Ram is a soldier sent by Vali, and he sends Lord Hanuman to investigate.

videos.title: Ravan Ka Gyaan
videos.overview: Lord Hanuman takes Shri Ram and Lakshman to Sugriva. Meanwhile, Ravan showcases his knowledge in front of Mata Sita in order to impress her.

videos.title: Mitrata Ka Sambandh
videos.overview: Sugriva tells Shri Ram the reason behind his exile to Rishyamukha mountain. Shri Ram and Sugriva decide to join hands and come together to defeat Vali.

videos.title: Sugriva Ki Shanka
videos.overview: Shri Ram advises Sugriva to challenge Vali to a battle. However, Sugriva is unsure about fighting his older brother. Meanwhile, Vibhishana apologises to Mata Sita for Ravan's actions.

videos.title: Sugriva Ki Chunauti
videos.overview: Meghanada confronts Ravan about his recent behaviour. Sugriva openly challenges Vali to a battle. However, Shri Ram is unable to help Sugriva, and Vali easily defeats him.

videos.title: Lanka Ki Samriddhi
videos.overview: Shri Ram asks Sugriva to wear a garland so that he can differentiate between him and his brother during their fight. Meanwhile, Ravan shows Mata Sita his throne room and tries to impress her with his wealth.

videos.title: Vali Aur Sugriva Ka Yudh
videos.overview: Sugriva challenges Vali to a fight once again. Angada takes Vali's wife, Tara, to the battlefield. Meanwhile, Shri Ram saves Sugriva and defeats Vali with an arrow.

videos.title: Kishkindha Mein Utsav
videos.overview: Sugriva and the others perform Vali's final rites. Sugriva gains the throne of Kishkindha and invites Shri Ram for a celebration. Meanwhile, Trijata has a change of heart when she sees Mata Sita standing up for herself in front of Ravan.

videos.title: Mata Sita Ki Khoj
videos.overview: Sugriva sends out his Vanar army to search for the place where Ravan is keeping Mata Sita. Meanwhile, Ravan shows Mata Sita the power of Lanka and introduces her to Kumbhakarna.

videos.title: Dhairya Aur Vishvaas Ki Pariksha
videos.overview: Shri Ram decides to halt the search for Mata Sita till the monsoon season ends. He instructs Sugriva to return to Kishkindha and take care of his kingdom. However, Sugriva doesn't return with his army even at the end of the monsoon season.

videos.title: Lakshman Ka Krodh
videos.overview: Sugriva acts carefree in his duties and is not willing to step out of his palace. When Lord Hanuman doesn't return, Lakshman decides to go to Kishkindha himself and reminds Sugriva of the promise he made to Shri Ram.

videos.title: Shri Ram Ki Sena
videos.overview: Shri Ram motivates the Vanar army to face Ravan's forces and find Mata Sita. Meanwhile, Ravan calls Mata Sita to attend his court.

videos.title: Asha Ka Deepak
videos.overview: None of the Vanars are able to find a clue about Mata Sita's location. Lord Hanuman's group encounters a dangerous Asura during their search. Meanwhile, Ravan asks his youngest son Akshayakumara to keep an eye on Mata Sita.

videos.title: Vanar Sena Ka Lakshya
videos.overview: Lord Hanuman and his group enter a magical cave while searching for Mata Sita. However, the cave turns out to be a maze with no escape in sight. How will they deal with the situation?

videos.title: Lanka Ka Marg
videos.overview: Lord Hanuman and his group reach the coast, but they have no means of travelling across the ocean and finding the location of Lanka. Meanwhile, Shri Ram gets information about Bharat from Ayodhya.

videos.title: Hanuman Ji Ki Katha
videos.overview: Jambavan helps Lord Hanuman recall his true power by narrating the story of his life. Meanwhile, Sugriva shows Shri Ram the stone idol Lord Hanuman had built for him.

videos.title: Maruti Ki Taakat
videos.overview: Jambavan continues to narrate the story of Lord Hanuman's childhood. While playing with his friends, a young Maruti mistakes the sun for a fruit and leaps towards the sky to pluck it. Lord Indra tries to stop Maruti, but he is not willing to listen.

videos.title: Gyaan Prapti Ki Katha
videos.overview: Lord Brahma brings Maruti back to life, and all the Devtas give him their blessings. Lord Indra gives Maruti the title of Hanuman. Later, young Lord Hanuman meets Surya Dev and wants to become his student.

videos.title: Sundara Kanda Ka Arambh
videos.overview: Young Lord Hanuman frequently troubles a group of Rishis and causes hindrances in their Yagyas. In response, the Rishis curse Lord Hanuman to forget all of his powers. With Jambavan's help, Lord Hanuman reawakens all of his dormant powers and makes his way towards Lanka.

videos.title: Mata Sita Ka Vishvaas
videos.overview: Varun Dev tries to create hindrances for Lord Hanuman to prevent him from reaching Lanka. Meanwhile, Akshayakumara arrives in Ashok Vatika with a threatening message for Mata Sita.

videos.title: Test For Lord Hanuman
videos.overview: Lord Hanuman continues to make his way to Lanka, but Naag Mata Surasa blocks his way. Meanwhile, Akshayakumara forbids everyone from bringing any food or water for Mata Sita.

videos.title: Lord Hanuman Enters Lanka
videos.overview: Lord Hanuman is stopped in his tracks by the demoness Simhika, who captures his shadow with her magic. However, Lord Hanuman defeats her with his unimaginable strength. Upon reaching Lanka, Lord Hanuman shrinks in size to sneak past Lankini, who is guarding the main gates.

videos.title: Search For Mata Sita
videos.overview: Lankini catches Lord Hanuman as he tries to sneak inside Lanka. However, Lord Hanuman defeats her and helps her attain Moksha. Meanwhile, Mandodari pays a visit to Mata Sita in Ashok Vatika.

videos.title: Shri Ram Ka Sandesh
videos.overview: Vibhishan tells Lord Hanuman the location where Mata Sita is being held. Meanwhile, Ravan confronts Mandodari about helping Mata Sita.

videos.title: Pativrata Dharam
videos.overview: Ravan arrives in Ashok Vatika and gives Mata Sita a marriage offer once again. Lord Hanuman is unable to step in and defend Mata Sita due to the promise he made to Shri Ram.

videos.title: Ravan Ka Shraap
videos.overview: Lord Hanuman appears before Mata Sita to give her Shri Ram's message. Mata Sita gives Lord Hanuman some vital information about Ravan's military strength. Meanwhile, Ravan tells Akshayakumara the story of the curse given to him by Nalakuvara.

videos.title: Chaos In Ashok Vatika
videos.overview: Lord Hanuman decides to cause chaos in Ashok Vatika to gain Ravan's attention. Ravan finds out about Lord Hanuman's actions, and he sends one of his generals to deal with the situation.

videos.title: Lord Hanuman Faces Akshayakumara
videos.overview: Lord Hanuman defeats the soldiers sent by Ravan with ease. In retaliation, Ravan sends Akshayakumara to deal with the situation in Ashok Vatika.

videos.title: Pratishod Ki Aag
videos.overview: Lord Hanuman defeats Akshayakumara. Later, Meghanada arrives in Ashok Vatika to face off against Lord Hanuman.

videos.title: Ravan Ka Abhimaan
videos.overview: Meghanada captures Lord Hanuman and takes him to Ravan. Lord Hanuman gives Ravan a chance to right his wrongs and respectfully return Mata Sita to Shri Ram.

videos.title: Sone Ki Lanka
videos.overview: Ravan orders his soldiers to light Lord Hanuman's tail on fire. However, his orders have the opposite effect, and the city of Lanka gets set on fire by Lord Hanuman.

videos.title: Mata Sita Ka Sandesh
videos.overview: After burning Lanka down, Lord Hanuman offers to take Mata Sita to Shri Ram. However, Mata Sita says that she will wait for Shri Ram to defeat Ravan.

videos.title: Dharam Yudh Ki Taiyaari
videos.overview: Lord Hanuman returns and gives Mata Sita's message to Shri Ram. Later, Sugriva and Shri Ram plan to declare war against Lanka.

videos.title: Shri Ram Ka Prayojan
videos.overview: Shri Ram's army begins their march towards Lanka. They reach the coast but have no means to cross. Meanwhile, Ravan prepares his soldiers for war.

videos.title: Lanka Ka Bhedi
videos.overview: Vibhishan cautions Ravan against going to war with Shri Ram. Meanwhile, the Vanar army feels demotivated when they are unable to find a freshwater source.

videos.title: Shri Ram Ka Vishvaas
videos.overview: Vibhishan and a few others ask to join Shri Ram and offer to help him defeat Ravan. No one is willing to believe Vibhishan's change of heart, but Lord Hanuman vouches for him.

videos.title: Shri Ram Ki Tapasya
videos.overview: Vibhishan suggests that Shri Ram should pray to Varun Dev to find a way to cross the ocean. Later, Ravan sends his soldiers to spy on Shri Ram and the Vanar army.

videos.title: Ravan Ka Guptchar
videos.overview: Vibhishan gets suspicious about Ravana's spies in the Vanar camp. Lord Hanuman finds the Rakshas named Shuka sneaking around the camp, and he presents him in front of Sugriva and Shri Ram.

videos.title: Ram Setu Ka Nirman
videos.overview: The Vanars prepare to build a bridge with Nal and Neel's help. Lord Hanuman writes Shri Ram's name on the rocks to make them float in water. Meanwhile, Meghanada takes it upon himself to stop the bridge from being built.

videos.title: Vanar Sena Ki Ekta
videos.overview: Meghanada sends his loyal soldier, Singhnand, to attack Shri Ram and stop the bridge from being built. Meanwhile, Lakshman is worried about the time it will take for the bridge to be built.

videos.title: Meghanada Ki Bhool
videos.overview: Lord Hanuman brings a mountain to help in building the bridge. After Singhnand's failure, Meghanada sends Prabhanjani to attack Shri Ram.

videos.title: Rameswaram Ki Sthapna
videos.overview: Lord Hanuman goes to the Himalayas to retrieve the Shivling. Later, Shri Ram establishes the Shivling on the coast and names the place as 'Rameswaram'.

videos.title: Ravan Ki Bhet
videos.overview: Shri Ram and the Vanar Sena make their way across the ocean on the bridge. Meanwhile, Ravan captures King Janak and brings him in front of Mata Sita.

videos.title: Shri Ram Reaches Lanka
videos.overview: Shri Ram and his Vanar army reach the shores of Lanka. Meanwhile, Ravan tries to deceive Mata Sita and claims to have defeated Shri Ram.

videos.title: Shanti Ka Sandesh
videos.overview: Shri Ram saves Sugriva from being defeated at the hands of Ravan. Later, Shri Ram sends Angad to Lanka as his messenger.

videos.title: Angad Ki Chunauti
videos.overview: Ravan rejects Shri Ram's peace offering. Angad challenges all the Rakshas to try and lift his foot. However, none of them is able to do so.

videos.title: Lanka Ka Abhimaan
videos.overview: Angad humiliates Ravan in front of everyone. Later, Shri Ram motivates the Vanar army before going to war with Ravan.

videos.title: Ravan Ki Maya
videos.overview: Shri Ram and the Vanars wait for daybreak to begin their attack. However, Ravan uses his magical powers to envelop the world in darkness so that his Rakshas army can fight with full power.

videos.title: Meghanada Ka Hamla
videos.overview: Shri Ram and the Vanar army overcome the first wave of attacks by Lanka. Meghanada enters the battlefield and tries to break the spirit of the Vanars with his powers.

videos.title: Yuddh Kaushal
videos.overview: Meghanada challenges Angad to a one-on-one battle. Meanwhile, Shri Ram faces two powerful Rakshasas from Ravan's army.

videos.title: Rakshason Ki Kamzori
videos.overview: Lord Hanuman shields Angad and faces Meghanada in battle. Meanwhile, Vibhishan gives some vital information to Shri Ram to gain an advantage against the Rakshasas.

videos.title: Ravan Ki Yuddh Neeti
videos.overview: Ravan enters the battlefield and faces Lord Hanuman. Meanwhile, the Rakshasas plan to separate Shri Ram from his Vanar army.

videos.title: Lord Hanuman Vs Ravan
videos.overview: Lord Hanuman overwhelms Ravan on the battlefield. However, Ravan uses his illusionary powers and gains an unfair advantage.

videos.title: Maya Ka Prayog
videos.overview: Lord Hanuman receives assistance from Shri Ram during his battle with Ravan. Ravan wields the powerful Chandrahas against Lord Hanuman. How will Lord Hanuman counter this formidable weapon?

videos.title: Ravan Ka Swarth Aur Abhimaan
videos.overview: Lakshman becomes ensnared in Ravan's deceptive maya, leaving even Shri Ram unable to rescue him. As tensions escalate, Ravan and Shri Ram confront each other directly. How will this intense and fierce battle unfold?

videos.title: Dharm Yudh
videos.overview: Ravan challenges Shri Ram for a face-to-face battle. Meanwhile, Vibhishan is worried for his brother Ravan. How will this fierce battle turn out?

videos.title: Shri Ram Ka Uchit Chayan
videos.overview: Ravan uses his Chandrahas on Shri Ram but Lord Shiva doesn't let it hurt him. A dejected Ravan goes back to his Lanka and prays to Lord Shiva. Later, Meghnath wakes up and is determined to fight Shri Ram.

videos.title: Vanar Sena Ka Shaurya
videos.overview: The Vanar sena celebrate their victory but Shri Ram believes that Ravan will attack again. Meanwhile, Mata Sita gets threatened in Lanka. Meghnath prays to Devi Nikumbala for strength and power. Later, Ravan's wife requests him to set Mata Sita free.

videos.title: Mahamaya Yudh
videos.overview: Meghnath sends demons towards Shri Ram and Lakshman to attack them in the night. This seems to weaken the vanar sena but Shri Ram uses the agni astra. Will he get rid of the demons?

videos.title: Ekta Hi Bal Hain
videos.overview: The vanar sena fights with the rakshas army but gets deceived by them. Shri Ram comes to their aid. Later, Meghnath in his chariot sets out to defeat Shri Ram and Lakshman. How will Meghnath be defeated?

videos.title: Lakshman Gets Hit
videos.overview: Lakshman continues fighting Meghnath and gets hit by his arrow followed by Shri Ram getting hit too. How will they come out of this situation?

videos.title: Meghnath's Trap
videos.overview: Lord Hanuman gives his all to free Shri Ram and Lakshman from Meghnath's trap. Ravan, proud of Meghnath, attends to his wounds. Who will come to Shri Ram and Lakshman's aid?

videos.title: Pakshiraj Garud Helps Shri Ram
videos.overview: Lord Hanuman seeks the aid of Pakshiraj Garud to free Shri Ram and Lakshman from the grips of Nagpash. Meanwhile, the vanar sena anxiously awaits Lord Hanuman's return, hoping for a miracle to save their beloved lord. What will be the outcome of this divine intervention?

videos.title: Narayan Ka Roop
videos.overview: Trijata informs Mata Sita that Shri Ram and Lakshman are out of danger and reveals that Shri Ram is the avatar of Narayan. However, when this news reaches Ravan, he refuses to believe it and immediately starts planning his next move to defeat Shri Ram.

videos.title: Chall Se Prahar
videos.overview: Dhumraksh and Lord Hanuman engage in an intense battle, resulting in Lord Hanuman triumphing over the demon. Meanwhile, Ravan begins preparing Vajramushti, a formidable warrior, to defeat Shri Ram in his ongoing quest for victory.

videos.title: Ahankaar Ka Ant
videos.overview: Angad asks for forgiveness for failing to defeat Vajramushti, but Shri Ram motivates and gives him a powerful sword to help overcome the demon. Later, Ravan sends Kampana to battle Shri Ram.

videos.title: Sangharsh Ka Saamna
videos.overview: Prahasta deceives Neel, but Lakshman rescues him just in time. Later, Shri Ram arrives to support them and motivates Neel to defeat Prahasta.

videos.title: Dharm Aur Maryada
videos.overview: Mata Sita assures Trijata that Shri Ram will defeat Ravan and return to Ayodhya before Amavas. Meanwhile, Ravan is determined to send Meghnath back to the battlefield, but Mandodari opposes the idea.

videos.title: Shri Ram Ke Siddhant
videos.overview: Shri Ram refuses to enter Lanka, deeming it unethical. Meanwhile, Lord Hanuman enters Lanka with the vanar sena, making his objective clear.

videos.title: Rise Of Kumbhakarna
videos.overview: Ravan sends his men to wake Kumbhakarna to fight Shri Ram. Meanwhile, the vanar sena causes havoc in Lanka.

videos.title: Nirbalta Ka Anarth
videos.overview: Kumbhakarna steps onto the battlefield, causing havoc. Vibhishan attempts to persuade his brother Kumbhakarna to surrender in the name of Shri Ram. Will Kumbhakarna listen to Vibhishan?

videos.title: Kumbhakarna Ka Keher
videos.overview: Lord Hanuman engages in a battle with Kumbhakarna, attempting to thwart his determination to defeat Shri Ram. How will Shri Ram bring an end to Kumbhakarna's rampage?

videos.title: Ravan Ka Krodh
videos.overview: Ravan is determined to avenge Kumbhakarna's death, despite Mandodari's attempts to dissuade him. Atikaya approaches Ravan, expressing his desire to battle Shri Ram and his army. How will Shri Ram overcome this new challenge?

videos.title: Dharm Ka Marg
videos.overview: Vibhishan warns Shri Ram that Atikaya is incredibly tough and can only be brought down with a powerful weapon called the Brahmastra. However, Shri Ram, known for his righteous conduct, is hesitant to use such a destructive weapon for fear of harming innocent bystanders. How will Atikaya be defeated?

videos.title: Shakti Yantra
videos.overview: Meghnath returns to the battleground to fight Shri Ram and the vanar sena, this time better prepared and armed with Nikumbala Devi's Shakti Yantra. How will Shri Ram overcome this powerful new challenge?

videos.title: Lakshman Gets Hit
videos.overview: Meghnath's Shakti Yantra strikes Lakshman, and Ravan celebrates his victory in Lanka. Meanwhile, Shri Ram desperately searches for a way to save his brother Lakshman.

videos.title: Shri Ram Ka Dard
videos.overview: Jambavant informs Shri Ram that only Sushen can offer a solution to heal Lakshman. Later, Lord Hanuman takes on the task of getting Sushen from Lanka.

videos.title: Shri Ram Aur Hanuman Ka Rishta
videos.overview: Ravan tasks Kalanemi with discovering Shri Ram's plan to save Lakshman. Meanwhile, Sushen informs Lord Hanuman about the Sanjeevani booti in the Himalayas that can heal Lakshman, and Hanuman sets out on a quest to retrieve it.

videos.title: Sanjeevani Booti
videos.overview: While Lakshman battles for his life, Lord Hanuman lifts an entire mountain to retrieve the Sanjeevani booti. On his way back, he is struck by an arrow from Shri Ram's brother Bharat. Will Lord Hanuman reach Lakshman in time to save him?

videos.title: Shri Ram Ki Aas
videos.overview: Lord Hanuman arrives with the entire mountain just before sunrise to save Lakshman's life. Later, upon learning about this, Ravan becomes furious and resolves to break Shri Ram's confidence. What will Ravan's next move be?

videos.title: Mata Sita Ka Sanghar
videos.overview: Shri Ram rallies the vanar sena for a battle against Ravan. Meghnath drags Mata Sita into the battlefield, issuing a dire threat to Shri Ram. How will Shri Ram confront and combat Meghnath's treachery?

videos.title: Maryada Ka Ant
videos.overview: Meghnath dramatically beheads Mata Sita right before Shri Ram's eyes, causing devastation among the vanar sena. Vibhishan attempts to reassure everyone that it was merely an illusion, but the heartbreak is palpable. Is Mata Sita truly alive, or will the vanar sena retreat in despair?

videos.title: Nikumbala Devi Ka Anushthan
videos.overview: Lakshman sets out to locate the Nikumbala cave and put an end to Meghnath's life for his deeds. However, with guards posted all around, will Lakshman be able to enter the cave before Meghnath completes the yagna?

videos.title: Antim Aahuti
videos.overview: Shri Ram battles the demons on the battlefield as Lakshman and Lord Hanuman navigate their way through the Nikumbala cave. Will Lakshman reach Meghnath in time to stop him before he completes the final aahuti?

videos.title: Vriksh Ki Chaaya
videos.overview: Meghnath's final aahuti is disrupted, leading to an intense fight with Lord Hanuman and Lakshman. Meanwhile, Shri Ram engages in a fierce battle with Makaraksh.

videos.title: Mata Sita Ke Apmaan Ka Badla
videos.overview: Vibhishan reminds Lakshman of his duties towards Shri Ram, motivating him to confront Meghnath. Will Lakshman succeed in ending Meghnath's reign of terror?

videos.title: Neelkamal
videos.overview: Ravan is devastated by Meghnath's death and fervently worships Lord Shiva, seeking strength to defeat Shri Ram. Meanwhile, Maharishi Agastya visits Shri Ram and tells him to do a yagya to impress Mahagauri.

videos.title: Shri Ram Ki Antim Aahuti
videos.overview: Shri Ram and Ravan each conduct their yagya in devotion to Mahagauri and Lord Shiv. However, Shri Ram fails to offer the crucial 108th aahuti of the Neelkamal. Will this failure prevent his yagya from being completed?

videos.title: Ravan's Yagya
videos.overview: Shri Ram and Lakshman battle Ravan's deceptive army, while Lord Hanuman confronts Mandodari, demanding that she reveal Ravan's location so they can disrupt his yagya.

videos.title: Yuddh Ki Antim Ratri
videos.overview: Lord Hanuman frantically searches for Shri Ram and Lakshman, who are imprisoned in the Patal Bhairvi temple. How will he manage to overcome this challenge and locate them?

videos.title: Lord Hanuman Aur Makardhwaj Ki Kahani
videos.overview: Lord Hanuman, unaware that he is fighting his own son Makardhwaj, battles to gain entry to Patal and rescue Shri Ram and Lakshman. Later, he manages to outwit Ahiravan and Mahiravan. Will he succeed in saving Shri Ram and Lakshman?

videos.title: End Of Ahiravan And Mahiravan
videos.overview: Lord Hanuman battles Ahiravan and Mahiravan fiercely. Later, he encounters Chandrasena, who reveals the method to defeat the demons. Will Lord Hanuman be able to end Ahiravan and Mahiravan's terror?

videos.title: Narayan Ke Bhakt
videos.overview: The people celebrate Lord Hanuman's return with Shri Ram and Lakshman. Ravan seeks forgiveness from Lord Shiva for his wrongdoings. Later, Lord Shiva recounts the story of Narayan's devoted followers, Jay and Vijay.

videos.title: Rakshas Sanskriti
videos.overview: Lord Shiva reveals to Mata Parvati that Ravan was Jay in his previous life. Later, Shri Ram and Ravan face each other in an epic battle.

videos.title: Ram Naam Ki Jaykar
videos.overview: Mata Parvati inquires with Lord Shiva about the events that followed in the battle between Shri Ram and Ravan. As they begin their fierce combat, Shri Ram and Ravan exchange arrows in their ongoing fight.

videos.title: Mrityu Ka Tandav
videos.overview: Ravan remains determined to defeat Shri Ram on the battlefield, and their fierce combat continues. Meanwhile, Vibhishan reveals to Shri Ram the key strategy to overcome Ravan.

videos.title: Dharm Ki Jeet Hui
videos.overview: Shri Ram puts an end to Ravan’s fury, leading Ravan to recognize that Shri Ram is the incarnation of Narayan. Shri Ram then instructs Lakshman to learn about Raj Dharm from Ravan.

videos.title: Vidhvansak Urja
videos.overview: After receiving Ravan's final blessings, his soul departs from his body. Later, Shri Ram senses that the war is not yet over and anticipates impending danger.

videos.title: Prem Aur Krodh
videos.overview: Shurpanakha arrives seeking revenge against Shri Ram, claiming that Mata Sita had accepted Ravan as her husband. Later, Lord Hanuman delivers the news to Mata Sita, telling her of Shri Ram's triumphant victory over Ravan.

videos.title: Dharm Aur Maryada Ki Sthaapna
videos.overview: Mata Sita prepares to reunite with Shri Ram, but the people of Lanka begin to question her character. Later, Shri Ram questions Mata Sita's purity.

videos.title: Mata Sita Ki Pavitrata Ka Pramaan
videos.overview: Mandodari reassures Shri Ram of Mata Sita's unwavering purity. Later, Mata Sita resolves to undergo the 'Agni Pariksha' to prove her chastity to everyone.

videos.title: Mata Sita Ki Agni Pariksha
videos.overview: Mata Sita emerges unscathed from the fire, proving her purity to all present. The onlookers seek blessings from Mata Sita and Shri Ram as they prepare to return to Ayodhya. Later, Shri Ram instructs Lord Hanuman to inform Bharat of their impending arrival.

videos.title: Paap Ka Ant
videos.overview: Shri Ram expresses to Mata Sita that her presence allowed him to demonstrate to the world that good always triumphs over evil. Lord Hanuman delivers the news of Shri Ram's return to Bharat. Later, Shri Ram and Mata Sita begin their journey back to Ayodhya.

videos.title: Bhagwan Ki Pratiksha
videos.overview: Lord Hanuman delivers the news to Bharat that Ayodhya eagerly awaits Shri Ram's return. Meanwhile, a distraught Shurpanakha desperately calls out to her brother for help.

videos.title: Prakriti Ki Maryada
videos.overview: The kingdom of Ayodhya is illuminated in celebration of Shri Ram's return. Later, Lord Hanuman boldly challenges Surya Dev.

videos.title: Sukhi Aur Surakshit Ayodhya
videos.overview: Shri Ram reunites with Bharat and hands him his padukaiye. With the blessings of Acharya, the 'Griha Pravesh' ceremony for Shri Ram and Mata Sita begins.

videos.title: Shri Ram Aa Rahe Hain
videos.overview: Ayodhya is filled with joy at the arrival of Shri Ram and Mata Sita. Later, Shri Ram insists that he will not participate in the 'Griha Pravesh' ceremony without Mata Kaikeyi by his side.

videos.title: Mata Kaikeyi Ka Ashish
videos.overview: Shri Ram invites Manthara to join his 'Griha Pravesh' ceremony, while Mata Sita requests her to persuade Mata Kaikeyi to perform the 'Griha Pravesh' puja. Later, Mata Kaikeyi arrives to meet Shri Ram.

videos.title: Shri Ram Ka Parivaar
videos.overview: Mata Sita urges Bharat to forgive Mata Kaikeyi and accept her apology, while Agastya Rishi decides to conduct Shri Ram's Rajya Abhishek. Later, Lakshman visits his wife Urmila.

videos.title: Jeevan Ki Antim Pariksha
videos.overview: Rajmata poses a question to the Rishimuni visiting Ayodhya, and all the ladies decide to offer prayers to Chhathi Mata. Later, Shri Ram has an encounter with two young children.

videos.title: Rajya Karya
videos.overview: Shri Ram decides to establish new sources of employment for the people of Ayodhya. Later, as preparations for Shri Ram's Rajya Abhishek are in full swing, a looming danger threatens the peace of Ayodhya.

videos.title: Shri Ram Ka Rajya Abhishek
videos.overview: Shri Ram's Rajya Abhishek commences, and the entire city of Ayodhya is filled with joy as they celebrate the crowning of their new king. Meanwhile, Lord Hanuman experiences pain in his leg and discusses it with Bharat. Later, Ravan's brother, disguised as an elderly man, approaches Mata Sita.

videos.title: Ram Rajya Ka Aarambh
videos.overview: Shri Ram is officially crowned as the king of Ayodhya, marking a moment of great celebration. During the ceremony, Lord Hanuman enters, covered in sindoor, and becomes the subject of mockery from those around. However, Mata Sita blesses Lord Hanuman, granting him the boon of being a 'Chiranjeevi'.

videos.title: Shri Ram Ka Yash
videos.overview: Ravan's brother persistently spreads rumours about Shri Ram, aiming to create discord and mistrust among the people of Ayodhya. Meanwhile, Lord Hanuman captures him, trying to prevent further chaos. The citizens, however, misunderstand Hanuman's actions and bring their grievances to Shri Ram. How will Shri Ram address this

videos.title: Mahabhoj Ki Taiyyari
videos.overview: Mata Sita decides to prepare a grand Mahabhoj for the Vanar Sena as a gesture of gratitude. Meanwhile, Shri Ram begins strategizing for the upcoming battle against Sahasramukh Ravan. Later, Shri Ram and Mata Sita receive the joyous news that they are soon to become parents.

videos.title: Ayodhya Ki Garima
videos.overview: Ayodhya rejoices upon hearing the wonderful news that Shri Ram and Mata Sita are soon to become parents. However, Sahasramukh Ravan once again spreads malicious rumours to disrupt the peace. Later, before Shri Ram embarks on his mission to defeat Bhaskand, Mata Sita presents him with a bow for protection and strength.

videos.title: Shri Ram Ki Seva
videos.overview: Lord Hanuman disguises himself as a warrior, eager to join the battle, but Shri Ram recognizes him. Hanuman then earnestly pleads with Shri Ram to allow him to accompany him into battle. Later, Shri Ram departs from Ayodhya, leading his forces to confront Bhaskand and his army.

videos.title: Satya Aur Dharm Ki Lau
videos.overview: Lakshman defeats Bhaskand's son in battle, while Shri Ram, with the assistance of Vayu Dev and Lord Hanuman, brings an end to Bhaskand's reign of terror. Meanwhile, Mata Sita anxiously awaits Shri Ram's safe return.

videos.title: Sahasramukh Ravan Ki Chunauti
videos.overview: Shri Ram embarks on a solitary mission to confront Sahasramukh Ravan, with Lord Hanuman discreetly following him. Later, Shri Ram and Lakshman return triumphantly to Ayodhya.

videos.title: Ram Rajya Par Dhabba
videos.overview: Shri Ram and Mata Sita conduct rituals in preparation for the arrival of their newborn baby, while Sahasramukh Ravan continues to incite the people of Ayodhya against them. Meanwhile, Mata Sita prepares a meal for the vanar sena.

videos.title: Hanuman Ka Hriday
videos.overview: The Vanar Sena prepares to return to Kishkindha as Shri Ram addresses them. However, Lord Hanuman refuses to leave and, in a profound display of devotion, tears open his chest to reveal that Shri Ram and Mata Sita reside within his heart.

videos.title: Raja Ka Kartavya
videos.overview: Shri Ram seeks a way to teach the people of Ayodhya about distinguishing right from wrong when a distressed woman comes to see him. Later, Shri Ram disguises himself as a common man to gain insight into the people's perspectives.

videos.title: Mata Sita Ka Faisala
videos.overview: Mata Sita confides in Rajmata, expressing her desire to remain in the forest. Meanwhile, Shri Ram is troubled by the opinions of the people of Ayodhya regarding Mata Sita. Later, overwhelmed with emotion, Shri Ram breaks down in front of Mata Sita.

videos.title: Pita Dharm Ki Pukaar
videos.overview: Mata Sita suggests the idea of staying in the forest to Shri Ram, leaving him deeply conflicted. Later, arrangements begin for Mata Sita’s departure to the forest.

videos.title: Shri Ram Ka Nirnay
videos.overview: Lakshman seeks permission to escort Mata Sita to the forest, while everyone in the kingdom is filled with sorrow and tears. Meanwhile, Kaikeyi pleads with Maharishi to persuade Shri Ram to reconsider and reverse his decision.

videos.title: Raja Ki Shaktiyan
videos.overview: Lakshman escorts Mata Sita to the forest, leaving Shri Ram deeply sorrowful and heartbroken. Meanwhile, Sahasramukh Ravan rejoices in what he believes is his victory, convinced that he has successfully defeated Shri Ram.

videos.title: Asurakshit Aur Apekshit
videos.overview: Lakshman expresses his concern to Mata Sita, warning her that the forest is not safe for her. Meanwhile, Lord Hanuman prays fervently to Lord Shiva, seeking divine intervention to support Shri Ram during this difficult time. Later, an important announcement is made to the residents of Ayodhya.

videos.title: Dharm Ki Maryada
videos.overview: Mata Sita finds herself surrounded by wild animals and prays to Shri Ram for protection. Meanwhile, Lord Hanuman approaches Shri Ram, seeking answers and guidance. Later, Shri Ram addresses the people of Ayodhya.

videos.title: Shri Ram Ka Balidaan
videos.overview: Lord Ganesh questions Lord Shiva about Shri Ram's actions, seeking deeper understanding. Meanwhile, Mata Sita is guided by Rishis to an ashram. Later, Kausalya Mata lovingly serves food to Shri Ram.

videos.title: Chall Ka Khel
videos.overview: Mata Sita moulds an idol of Shri Ram from mud and vows not to eat until he has been fed. Later, a man arrives at the darbar to apologize to Shri Ram for his wrongdoings. Meanwhile, Surpanakha confronts Sahasramukh Ravan.

videos.title: Lavnasur Creates Havoc
videos.overview: Sahasramukh Ravan meets Lavnasur and reminds him of his duties. Meanwhile, Shri Ram learns that Lavnasur has caused chaos in the forest and the ashram where Mata Sita resides. Later, Mata Sita gives birth to her sons.

videos.title: Luv Aur Kush Ka Janm
videos.overview: Mata Sita gives birth to her two sons, Luv and Kush. Meanwhile, Shatrughna embarks to defeat Lavnasur and eventually arrives at the ashram where Mata Sita is staying.

videos.title: Sansar Ki Palan Shakti
videos.overview: Shatrughna visits Mata Sita at the ashram, humbly receiving her blessing and meeting Luv and Kush for the first time. Mata Sita requests him not to inform Shri Ram about their sons' birth. Later, Shatrughna successfully defeats Lavnasur.

videos.title: Shri Ram Ka Dukh Aur Vishwas
videos.overview: Lakshman, overwhelmed with guilt, apologizes to Shri Ram after witnessing his deep sorrow over Mata Sita. Meanwhile, Luv and Kush have grown up, and Mata Sita goes in search of them, eventually disciplining them for their mischief. Later, Shri Ram announces his decision to perform the Ashvamedha Yajna.

videos.title: Dharm Aur Ram Rajya
videos.overview: Shri Ram instructs Acharya Ji to start preparations for the Ashvamedha Yajna. Meanwhile, Sahasramukh Ravan plots to bring destruction to Ram Rajya and disrupt the Yajna. Later, in the ashram, Luv and Kush impress everyone with their remarkable archery skills.

videos.title: Ram Rajya Ki Neev
videos.overview: Luv and Kush are scolded for their mischief, while Sahasramukh Ravan devises a cunning plan to manipulate the two brothers as a way to get closer to Mata Sita.

videos.title: Veer Aur Parakrami Putra
videos.overview: Sahasramukh Ravan's plan to harm Luv and Kush in the forest fails, leaving him frustrated. Meanwhile, Mata Sita turns to Acharya ji for guidance regarding her sons' safety and future. As danger continues to loom, a group of asurs plot to attack Luv and Kush, putting them at further risk.

videos.title: Chandra Bahu Se Yudh
videos.overview: Luv and Kush recount their jungle adventure to the other children at the ashram. Meanwhile, Shri Ram arrives in Kishkindha to assist Sugriva in his battle against Chandra Bahu.

videos.title: Aatmashuddhi
videos.overview: Mata Sita expresses her desire to undergo Aatmashuddhi, and Luv and Kush choose to accompany her on this spiritual journey. Meanwhile, Shri Ram, Lord Hanuman, and the others devise a plan to disrupt Rani Padma's Jaap. Later, Sahasramukh Ravan cunningly befriends Luv and Kush in the forest.

videos.title: Ghor Vipada
videos.overview: Luv and Kush face off against a fierce ox sent by Sahasramukh Ravan, attempting to tame the wild creature. Meanwhile, Shri Ram engages in battle with Chandra Bahu's army. Later, Sahasramukh Ravan enlists Makarasur to launch an attack on Mata Sita and her sons.

videos.title: Makarasur Ka Prahar
videos.overview: Sahasramukh Ravan provokes Makarasur to stand against Shri Ram. Mata Sita takes a bold decision to protect the village and face Makarasur. Meanwhile, Luv and Kush courageously battle Makarasur's army while Lord Hanuman shatters Chandra Bahu's weapon.

videos.title: Mukti Ka Marg
videos.overview: Rishi Asuri awakens from his deep tapasya as Mata Sita is absorbed by the waters, leaving Luv and Kush desperately trying to save her. Determined, Luv and Kush devise a bold plan to battle Makarasur and rescue their mother.

videos.title: Chandra Bahu Ka Ant
videos.overview: Lord Hanuman rescues Angad from an asur, while Luv and Kush convince Jal Devi to help build a dam. With Lord Hanuman's assistance, Shri Ram defeats Chandra Bahu.

videos.title: Mata Sita Ki Tapasya
videos.overview: Makarasur and Sahasramukh Ravan attempt to disrupt Mata Sita's tapasya, but are unable to approach her. Meanwhile, Luv and Kush bravely battle Makarasur's army, but during the fight, Kush gets injured.

videos.title: Chandra Bahu Ka Adharm
videos.overview: Following the death of her husband, Rani Padma accuses Shri Ram of deception and dishonesty. Meanwhile, Luv and Kush receive aid from a neighbouring king to confront Makarasur. Later, they boldly enter Makarasur's palace.

videos.title: Pratibimb
videos.overview: Shri Ram informs Lord Hanuman and the others that he plans to hand over the kingdom to Bharat and embark on a journey to find Mata Sita. Meanwhile, Luv and Kush triumph over Makarasur and successfully rescue their mother.

videos.title: Makarasur Ka Vadh
videos.overview: The Maharaj and the villagers rejoice in Luv and Kush's victory. Meanwhile, Mata Sita struggles to confront her father. Later, an asur abducts Luv and Kush's friend Somkaran. How will Luv and Kush save him?

videos.title: Van Devi Ka Mandir
videos.overview: Devi Falgu expresses her desire for Luv and Kush to construct Van Devi's temple by the shore. Meanwhile, the Asurs threaten Somkaran, creating a tense situation. Upon Shri Ram's return to Ayodhya, he discovers his brothers engaged in the Pitra Yagya.

videos.title: Purvajo Ka Aashirwaad
videos.overview: Luv and Kush embark on a mission to rescue their friend Somkaran, unaware that Asur Raktketu has set a trap for them. Meanwhile, Shri Ram and his brothers receive blessings from their ancestors.

videos.title: Shri Ram Ka Dharam Sankat
videos.overview: Shri Ram finds himself in a dilemma regarding his second marriage. Meanwhile, Luv and Kush attempt to escape from a cave after rescuing their friend Somkaran. Later, Shri Ram declares his plans to organize the Ashvamedh Yagya.

videos.title: Shri Ram Sets Out For Mithila
videos.overview: Raja Janak recounts the courageous tale of Luv and Kush to his wife. Luv and Kush decide to travel to Mithila to compete in the upcoming contest. Meanwhile, Shri Ram also prepares to journey to Mithila.

videos.title: Ayodhya Naresh Ka Vishesh Swagat
videos.overview: Raja Janak prepares a grand welcome for Shri Ram, but the people of Mithila oppose the idea, believing that Mata Sita's suffering is due to Shri Ram. Meanwhile, Luv and Kush begin searching for Shri Ram in Mithila.

videos.title: Bal Aur Buddhi Ke Dhani
videos.overview: Luv and Kush find themselves surrounded by Sainiks but manage to escape. Meanwhile, Raja Janak informs Shri Ram about the brave brothers. Later, Shri Ram invites Raja Janak to the Ashvamedh Yagya.

videos.title: Shri Ram Ka Swagat
videos.overview: The Sainiks chase after Luv, Kush, and their friends. Meanwhile, the people of Mithila gather to welcome Shri Ram at the grand Bhavya Utsav. Later, Luv and Kush lay eyes on their father, Shri Ram, for the first time.

videos.title: Spardha Ka Aarambh
videos.overview: Raja Janak warmly welcomes Shri Ram while searching for Luv and Kush. As the competition begins, Shri Ram is confident that Luv and Kush will participate. Will the two brothers finally get the chance to meet their father?

videos.title: Mahanta Ka Prateek
videos.overview: Luv and Kush continue to demonstrate their skills in the competition while staying out of Shri Ram's sight. Shri Ram expresses his desire to meet them in person. Later, he sets out himself to search for Luv and Kush.

videos.title: Rishikumaro Ki Jai
videos.overview: Luv and Kush successfully tame Raja Janak's horse, earning admiration from everyone. Meanwhile, Sahasramukh Ravan tortures Somkaran, but Shri Ram arrives just in time to save him. Later, Mata Sita and the others warmly welcome Upguru and his newlywed wife.

videos.title: Ayodhya Jaane Ki Uttejana
videos.overview: Luv and Kush are thrilled about their upcoming journey to Ayodhya. Meanwhile, Shri Ram introduces his new wife to the people of Ayodhya ahead of the Ashwamedh Yagya, receiving their approval.

videos.title: Sukh Ki Anubhuti
videos.overview: Luv and Kush begin their journey to Ayodhya, but along the way, they come across someone in need of help. Meanwhile, Sahasramukh Ravan hatches a dark plan to disrupt the preparations for the Ashwamedh Yagya.

videos.title: Jeev KI Niyati
videos.overview: Shri Ram instructs his soldiers to search for the missing horses. Meanwhile, Luv and Kush assist an elderly couple and successfully rescue their daughter.

videos.title: Shri Ram Ke Sacche Bhakt
videos.overview: With the blessings of the Shaligram, the elderly couple’s eyesight is miraculously restored, while Lord Hanuman locates the missing horse. Later, Luv and Kush arrive in Ayodhya for the Ashwamedh Yagya, only to find themselves unable to enter the kingdom.

videos.title: Ram Katha Ka Gaan
videos.overview: Shri Ram warmly welcomes Raja Janak and introduces him to his wife. Meanwhile, to gain entry into Ayodhya, Luv and Kush sing praises of Shri Ram. Later, Lord Hanuman shares with Shri Ram the story of Luv and Kush’s Ram Katha.

videos.title: Gyaan Aur Agyaan
videos.overview: Sahasramukh Ravan devises a plan to create conflict between Shri Ram and Luv-Kush. Upon learning that Shri Ram and Mata Sita are not united, Luv and Kush feel disheartened. Later, they have an encounter with Lord Hanuman.

videos.title: Shri Ram Se Milne Ki Uttejana
videos.overview: Lord Hanuman arrives to welcome Luv and Kush, preparing to introduce them to Shri Ram. Entering the kingdom, they sing Shri Ram's praises before Raja Janak, impressing everyone present.

videos.title: Nirasha Mein Bhi Aasha
videos.overview: Shri Ram grants Luv and Kush a protective 'dhaaga' as a blessing. Later, Luv and Kush learn that Shri Ram has separated from Mata Sita, and they express their disappointment to him.

videos.title: Ashwamedh Yagya Ka Ashwa
videos.overview: Shri Ram begins the Ashwamedh Yagya. On their journey back, Luv and Kush come across Sahasramukh Ravan disguised as an ordinary man. Determined, Luv decides to halt the Ashwa before Shri Ram can complete the Yagya.

videos.title: Dharm Ki Maang
videos.overview: Luv and Kush express their disappointment with Shri Ram's decisions in front of Mata Sita and share their intention to search for her. Later, Shri Ram releases the Ashwa and sends it northward.

videos.title: Rakshasi Maya
videos.overview: As Luv and Kush journey to find Mata Sita, they come across Sahasramukh Ravan disguised as a commoner, who asks to accompany them. They soon arrive at a village afflicted by a disease. Meanwhile, Shri Ram engages in 'Gau Seva'.

videos.title: Sahasramukh Ravan Ka Prakop
videos.overview: Sahasramukh Ravan devises a scheme to expose the truth about Shri Ram to Luv and Kush. Meanwhile, Lakshman and Bharat question Shri Ram?s decision to allow Shatrughna to go alone with the Ashwa. Later, Luv and Kush manage to tame the Ashwa while the soldiers search for it.

videos.title: Swarn Kamal Ki Talash
videos.overview: Luv and Kush search for the Swarn Kamal and offer prayers to Jal Devi while Shatrughna and his army pursue them. They enter Kuber Nagri and Shatrughna confronts Lord Kuber. Later, Shri Ram offers prayers to Brahma Dev.

videos.title: Luv-Kush Ke Gyaan Ki Pariksha
videos.overview: Luv and Kush confront Lord Kuber when he denies them the Swarn Kamal, prompting him to test their knowledge. Meanwhile, Shatrughna persists in his search for Luv and Kush to reclaim the Ashwa.

videos.title: Mann Ki Chinta
videos.overview: Mata Sita grows concerned for Shri Ram. Meanwhile, an Asur attempts to harm the Ashwa but faces punishment instead. Later, Luv and Kush confront Shatrughna and his army.

videos.title: Parajay Sweekar
videos.overview: Lord Hanuman requests Shri Ram’s permission to aid Shatrughna in his battle. Meanwhile, Luv and Kush successfully hold off Shatrughna and his army. Later, they retrieve the 'Jadi Buti' that can help heal the village.

videos.title: Luv-Kush Ki Jai
videos.overview: Luv and Kush are celebrated as heroes after saving the village from the disease, sharing the story of how they discovered the right Jadi Buti. Meanwhile, Lord Hanuman continues his search for Shatrughna and the Ashwa.

videos.title: Bal Aur Abhimaan
videos.overview: Lakshman, upset over what happened to Shatrughna, urges Shri Ram to summon Luv and Kush. Meanwhile, Luv and Kush return to the Ashram with the Swarn Kamal. Later, Lord Hanuman faces off against Banasur.

videos.title: Rakshasi Soch
videos.overview: Lord Hanuman confronts Sahasramukh Ravan, delivering a powerful lesson. Meanwhile, Luv and Kush recount their adventure to Mata Sita. Later, Lakshman readies his army to face Luv and Kush.

videos.title: Rishi Agastya Ko Pranaam
videos.overview: Luv and Kush return to their Ashram as kings. Meanwhile, Lord Hanuman, disguised as a child, grows suspicious that they might be Shri Ram's sons. Later, with Ayodhya's threat looming, Luv and Kush meet Rishi Agastya.

videos.title: Lord Hanuman Meets Mata Sita
videos.overview: Lord Hanuman seeks Mata Sita's blessings during their meeting. Meanwhile, the villagers deny Lakshman entry into the village, insisting that he first seek Luv's permission.

videos.title: Shri Ram Ke Virodhi
videos.overview: The villagers block Lakshman’s entry into the village, standing armed. Meanwhile, Lord Hanuman seeks information about Luv and Kush from Mata Sita. Later, Hanuman meets the brothers and offers them his assistance.

videos.title: Shraddha Aur Samarpan
videos.overview: Sahasramukh Ravan commands his men to locate the Ashwa. Meanwhile, Lord Hanuman requests Luv and Kush to sing the Ram Katha, but they refuse. At the same time, Lakshman desperately searches for Shatrughna.

videos.title: Raja Ka Kartavya
videos.overview: Luv and Kush find themselves surrounded by ghosts and confront their king with courage. Meanwhile, Lakshman locates Shatrughna and becomes furious with Luv and Kush. Will Lakshman decide to punish the Rishikumars?

videos.title: Lakshman Ka Krodh
videos.overview: An enraged Lakshman threatens the villagers, demanding to know Luv and Kush's whereabouts. Meanwhile, Luv and Kush offer prayers to Shani Dev, seeking his assistance. Later, Shri Ram instructs Bharat to confront the Rishikumars.

videos.title: Luv-Kush Ki Duvidha
videos.overview: Sahasramukh Ravan devises a scheme to create conflict between Shri Ram and his sons. Meanwhile, Bharat intervenes to calm Lakshman’s rising anger. Lord Hanuman attempts to persuade Luv and Kush to return the Ashwa.

videos.title: Ashwa Ki Raksha
videos.overview: Luv and Kush grow anxious as the Ashwa is taken away by the Asur. Meanwhile, Lord Hanuman is ensnared by a serpent, and Lakshman prepares to confront Luv and Kush.

videos.title: Ashwa Ki Talash
videos.overview: Luv and Kush, accompanied by Lord Hanuman, search for the Ashwa, while Mata Sita grows anxious when Somkaran returns to the Ashram without them. Will Luv and Kush succeed in finding the Ashwa in time?

videos.title: Luv-Kush Ka Rajdroh
videos.overview: Luv, Kush, and Lord Hanuman race against time, with only until sunset to locate the Ashwa. Meanwhile, Lakshman arrives at the Ashram in search of the Rishikumars, as Shri Ram addresses the people of Ayodhya about the missing Ashwa.

videos.title: Bhakti Ka Marg
videos.overview: Luv and Kush choose to battle Lord Hanuman for the Ashwa and manage to capture him. Meanwhile, Mata Sita's prayers are interrupted by a group of men.

videos.title: Devi Ki Pooja
videos.overview: Mata Sita is advised not to pray to Mata Tripura Sundari as King Dhanyamali is expected to arrive. Meanwhile, Lakshman issues a final warning to Luv and Kush and confronts them with a challenge.

videos.title: Luv Aur Kush Ka Sahas
videos.overview: Mata Sita remains steadfast in her prayers, undeterred by the threats to her life. Meanwhile, Lakshman confronts Luv and Kush in a face-off. Later, Shri Ram receives the news of Lakshman's defeat.

videos.title: Udandta Ki Seema
videos.overview: Shri Ram, enraged upon learning about Lakshman's defeat, decides to confront Luv and Kush personally. Meanwhile, Mata Sita and Luv-Kush face off against King Dhanyamali and his army.

videos.title: Sahasramukh Ka Prahaar
videos.overview: Luv and Kush fiercely battle King Dhanyamali's army to safeguard Mata Sita, while Lord Hanuman defends the Ashwa from Sahasramukh Ravan's forces. Eventually, King Dhanyamali's men apologize to Mata Sita.

videos.title: Bharat Ke Mann Ki Chinta
videos.overview: Bharat confides in Shri Ram, expressing his feelings of failure. Meanwhile, Luv and Kush worry that Mata Sita might discover the truth about the Ashwa and reprimand them. Will Mata Sita uncover what happened?

videos.title: Bharat Ki Chetavani
videos.overview: Kush pleads with everyone at the Ashram to keep the missing Ashwa a secret from Mata Sita. Luv and Kush offer Lord Hanuman food prepared by Mata Sita. Later, Bharat confronts Luv and Kush, issuing a warning as he readies his bow against them.

videos.title: Luv-Kush Ke Praan Ko Sankat
videos.overview: Bharat confronts Luv and Kush, while Lord Hanuman intervenes to stop him. Meanwhile, the crops at the Ashram are destroyed, and Bharat’s army overpowers the Rishikumars. Will Luv and Kush remain safe?

videos.title: Luv Aur Kush Ki Ranneeti
videos.overview: Luv and Kush find themselves encircled by Bharat and his army. Meanwhile, Mata Sita enters the fire to rescue a child. Later, Sugriva and Vibhishan arrive to confront Luv and Kush after Bharat is injured.

videos.title: Antaraatma Ka Dharm
videos.overview: Mata Sita emerges unscathed from the fire, thwarting Sahasramukh's plan. Sugriva and Vibhishan confront Luv and Kush, demanding they surrender the Ashwa. Later, the Vanar Sena engages in battle with Luv and Kush.

videos.title: Sugriva Ka Gussa
videos.overview: Mata Sita bravely confronts the wolf, while Luv and Kush stand against Sugriva's fury. Will Sugriva overpower the Rishikumars?

videos.title: Van Devi Ka Satya
videos.overview: The residents of the Ashram demand answers about Van Devi. Lord Hanuman turns to Mahadev for guidance to safeguard Mata Sita. Meanwhile, Luv and Kush confront Angad.

videos.title: Ayodhya Ka Gaurav
videos.overview: Luv and Kush boldly challenge the formidable Angad to a battle. Meanwhile, Mata Sita grows anxious for their safety and sets out in search of them. Later, Shri Ram raises his arrow against the Rishikumars.

videos.title: Yagya Ka Antim Charan
videos.overview: Shri Ram embarks on a mission to retrieve the Ashwa. Meanwhile, Asurs disguised as Luv and Kush set fire to the village, enraging Shri Ram. Later, Shri Ram and the real Luv and Kush come face to face.

videos.title: Shri Ram Aur Luv-Kush Ki Beth
videos.overview: Shri Ram and Luv-Kush come face to face as Mata Sita searches for her sons. Will the Rishikumars engage in battle with their revered Shri Ram?

videos.title: Shri Ram Ke Nirnaye Par Prashna
videos.overview: Luv and Kush confront Shri Ram, urging him to search for Mata Sita, while Shri Ram accuses them of burning down the village. Will this misunderstanding lead to a battle between them?

videos.title: Luv-Kush Ka Dharm Aur Kartavya
videos.overview: Mata Sita ventures out alone to confront the impending danger, keeping her departure a secret from everyone at the Ashram. Meanwhile, Shri Ram questions Luv and Kush about whether they informed their mother about the battle. Later, Mata Sita finds herself surrounded by Asurs.

videos.title: Ayodhya Ka Maan Sammaan
videos.overview: Maa Parvati safeguards Mata Sita from Sahasramukh Ravan’s wicked scheme. Shri Ram and Luv-Kush exchange arrows in a fierce confrontation. Meanwhile, the Gods grow anxious, witnessing the father and sons in conflict.

videos.title: Niyati Ka Antim Avsar
videos.overview: As the sun sets, Shri Ram issues a final warning to Luv and Kush. Lord Hanuman advises the Rishikumars to summon their mother. Meanwhile, Sahasramukh Ravan fears for his life.

videos.title: Dharm Ki Shakti
videos.overview: Shri Ram reunites with his army, wounded by the arrows of Luv and Kush. Meanwhile, the Rishikumars resolve to confront Shri Ram despite his warnings. Elsewhere, Mata Sita comes face-to-face with Sahasramukh Ravan.

videos.title: Sahasramukh Ravan Ki Chunauti
videos.overview: Sahasramukh Ravan issues a challenge to Mata Sita as Luv and Kush search for her. Later, Mata Sita transforms into Goddess Lakshmi to face Sahasramukh Ravan.

videos.title: Bhalai Ki Lau
videos.overview: Luv and Kush discover Mata Sita lying unconscious. Sahasramukh Ravan confronts Shurpanakha for hiding the truth about Mata Sita being an incarnation of Goddess Lakshmi. Meanwhile, Shri Ram rescues Lakshman from the raging fire.

videos.title: Prahaar Ka Samay
videos.overview: Shri Ram rescues his army from the raging fire as Mata Sita moves closer to reuniting with him. Meanwhile, Luv and Kush offer food to Lord Hanuman and seek his guidance.

videos.title: Ashram Ka Marg
videos.overview: Shurpanakha spies on Luv and Kush, disguising herself as an old woman. Later, the Rishikumars cleverly escape the cave and make their way to the battleground to confront Shri Ram.

videos.title: Kalank Aur Lanchan
videos.overview: As Arya Sumant leads the Ashwa, Luv and Kush prepare to confront Shri Ram by raising their bows. Lord Hanuman attempts to reveal the truth to both Shri Ram and the Rishikumars, but his words go unheard. What destiny awaits Luv and Kush?

videos.title: Mahadev Ka Samay Chakra
videos.overview: Shri Ram and Luv-Kush come face-to-face as Sahasramukh Ravan revels in his triumph. Lord Shiva offers solace to a distressed Lord Hanuman, while Mata Sita grows increasingly anxious for her sons' safety.

videos.title: Kaha Hain Luv-Kush?
videos.overview: Mata Sita questions Somkaran about Luv and Kush's whereabouts. Meanwhile, Shri Ram and the Rishikumars remain locked in an intense battle. Concerned for her sons, Mata Sita prays fervently to Lord Shiva for their protection.

videos.title: Upastithi Ka Rahasya
videos.overview: Luv and Kush return and confront Shri Ram, standing resolutely before him. Maharishi Bharadwaj arrives with a remedy to heal Shri Ram's injured brothers. Meanwhile, Mata Sita reunites with her sons, and later, Luv and Kush reveal the entire truth to her.

videos.title: Pita Ki Chhaya
videos.overview: Mata Sita, disappointed by Luv and Kush's actions, decides on a severe punishment for them and questions Lord Hanuman about the ongoing battle.

videos.title: Mata Sita Ka Dukh
videos.overview: Luv and Kush are deeply remorseful for causing pain to their mother. Mata Sita begins her tapasya, seeking the well-being of her family. Meanwhile, Shri Ram expresses gratitude to Maharishi Bharadwaj for saving his brothers' lives.

videos.title: Hanumanji Ki Chinta
videos.overview: Lord Hanuman grapples with confusion over Rishi Bharadwaj’s silence about Luv and Kush’s true identity to Shri Ram. Mata Sita ends her tapasya following Lord Valmiki’s intervention. Later, Luv and Kush vow to uphold Mata Sita’s purity in Ayodhya.

videos.title: Sahasramukh Ka Krodh
videos.overview: Sahasramukh Ravan erupts in anger as Shurpanakha attempts to pacify him. Meanwhile, Shri Ram shares a meal with his brothers and army. Later, Luv and Kush embark on their journey to Ayodhya.

videos.title: Mrityu Ka Marg
videos.overview: Luv and Kush set out for Ayodhya, facing obstacles created by Sahasramukh Ravan along the way. Meanwhile, Shri Ram proceeds with the Ashwamedh Yagya.

videos.title: Luv-Kush KI Yojana
videos.overview: Luv and Kush venture into the cave to rescue the villagers, while Ayodhya eagerly awaits their arrival. Will they succumb to Sahasramukh Ravan's cunning trap?

videos.title: Shudhhata Ka Marg
videos.overview: Luv and Kush thwart Sahasramukh Ravan's trap by rescuing the villagers from the cave. Later, the Rishikumars work to inspire a shift in the villagers' perspectives on women.

videos.title: Sansaar Ka Uddharan
videos.overview: Luv and Kush, determined to restore their mother's honor, continue their journey. However, they encounter a fierce lion, a trap cunningly laid by Shurpanakha. Will they overcome this challenge?

videos.title: Kush Ki Peeda
videos.overview: Kush gets injured as Luv and Rishi Bharadwaj work to heal him. Meanwhile, Mata Sita grows anxious for her sons' safety.

videos.title: Mamta Ka Bal
videos.overview: Luv rescues Kush from the scorching lava and battles the demons as the poison in Kush's body spreads quickly. Later, they encounter a challenging maze. Can they find their way through?

videos.title: Sahayta Ki Pukaar
videos.overview: Luv and Kush turn to Shri Ram in prayer, seeking his guidance and support. Meanwhile, Shri Ram questions Lord Hanuman about how Luv and Kush managed to capture him. Later, Kush's condition worsens significantly.

videos.title: Uddeshya Path Ka Marg
videos.overview: The residents of Ayodhya block Luv and Kush from entering the city as the brothers attempt to explain their stance. Later, they make their way to the royal court and come face-to-face with Shri Ram.

videos.title: Luv-Kush Ki Maafi
videos.overview: Luv and Kush apologize to Lakshman for their earlier accusations and confront Shri Ram in the royal court. Meanwhile, Sahasramukh Ravan and Shurpanakha strategize their next plan.

videos.title: Shri Ram Ka Saral Jeevan
videos.overview: Luv and Kush are astonished to witness Shri Ram leading a humble life despite being a king. Determined to transform the people of Ayodhya's perception of women, they take action. Later, all the women in Ayodhya mysteriously disappear. What could Luv and Kush be planning?

videos.title: Purush Ki Soch
videos.overview: The women fear being abandoned by the men due to their recent actions. Luv and Kush try to reason with the men, but their efforts go unheard. How will they bring about a change in society?

videos.title: Stree Aur Purush Ka Samman
videos.overview: The women of Ayodhya, supported by Luv and Kush, take a stand against the men. Meanwhile, the men struggle to handle household chores on their own. Will this teach them to value and respect women?

videos.title: Luv-Kush Ka Dusra Uddeshya
videos.overview: At Luv and Kush's request, the people of Ayodhya gather in the royal court before Shri Ram. The brothers sing the Ram Katha, moving everyone to tears. Overwhelmed with emotion, the people apologize to Shri Ram for exiling Mata Sita from Ayodhya.

videos.title: Shri Ram Ke Putra
videos.overview: Luv and Kush disclose in the royal court that they are the sons of Shri Ram and Mata Sita. Later, Lord Hanuman and others request Shri Ram's permission to bring Mata Sita back home.

videos.title: Luv Kush Ka Naman
videos.overview: Luv and Kush reunite with their grandmother and seek a way to convince Shri Ram to bring Mata Sita back to Ayodhya. Meanwhile, Lord Hanuman visits Mata Sita.

videos.title: Raghukul Ke Viruddh Yudh
videos.overview: Sahasramukh Ravan unleashes Atharvasur, determined to prevent the completion of the Ramayana. Meanwhile, Lord Hanuman presents Shri Ram with food prepared by Mata Sita. Lakshman, Luv, Kush, and others devise a plan to bring Mata Sita back to Ayodhya.

videos.title: Sahasramukh Ka Badla
videos.overview: Shri Ram resolves to take on Sahasramukh Ravan and his forces alone. Meanwhile, Kausalya, Lakshman, and others arrive at the Ashram to bring Mata Sita back home. Later, Shri Ram confronts Sahasramukh, while Lord Hanuman battles Atharvasur.

videos.title: Dharm Sthapna
videos.overview: Shri Ram confronts Shurpanakha meanwhile Lord Hanuman fights with Atharvasur. How will this battle end?

videos.title: Vibhishan Arrives To Aid Shri Ram
videos.overview: Vibhishan tells Lord Ram that only a woman can defeat Sahastramukh. Meanwhile, Lord Hanuman attempts to convince Mata Sita.

videos.title: Khatre Mein Luv Aur Kush
videos.overview: Mata Sita and Lord Hanuman are frantic with worry as they search for Luv and Kush, but the twins are nowhere to be found. Will they be reunited safely?

videos.title: Mrityu Ke Liye Sajj
videos.overview: As Sahasramukh overpowers Shri Ram, Mata Sita arrives and reunites with him after years. Taking the fierce avatar of Goddess Kali, she slays Sahasramukh Ravan.

videos.title: Ram Parivaar Ka Milan
videos.overview: Mata Sita puts an end to Sahasramukh Ravan's tyranny and confronts Shurpanakha after her brother's demise. Later, she returns to Ayodhya, where the residents seek her forgiveness for their harsh words.

videos.title: Ayodhya Mein Shubh Din
videos.overview: Shri Ram, alongside Mata Sita, addresses the people of Ayodhya, while Shurpanakha schemes her next act of revenge.

videos.title: Maleen Charitra
videos.overview: All of Ayodhya rejoices at Mata Sita's arrival. Meanwhile, a peasant suggests that she should undergo an Agni Pariksha angering the other citizens.

videos.title: Ayodhya Ka Dhwaj
videos.overview: Raja Janak reunites with Mata Sita and her grandsons. Meanwhile, the Asurs invade Ayodhya in search of Luv and Kush. Will the brothers remain safe?

videos.title: Saam Daam Dand Bhed
videos.overview: Luv and Kush confront and defeat Shurpanakha. Later, as a lady's saree catches fire in the darbar, the peasant approaches Shri Ram to talk to him about Mata Sita.

videos.title: Aadharheen Prashna
videos.overview: A few people of Ayodhya approach the darbar, demanding that Mata Sita undergo an Agni Pariksha, angering Lakshman, Lord Hanuman, and others. How will Shri Ram respond?

videos.title: Ayodhya Ka Durbhagya
videos.overview: Lord Hanuman, Lakshman, and Bharat apologize to Mata Sita for all she has endured. Later, Bhagwan Valmiki blesses her and gives her a solution.

videos.title: Stree Ki Pariksha
videos.overview: The residents of Ayodhya gather to witness Mata Sita's Agni Pariksha. As she arrives at the darbar, Luv and Kush step in, questioning the crowd.

videos.title: Maryada Ki Raksha
videos.overview: Mata Sita stands before the darbar, refusing to undergo the Agni Pariksha. Instead, she chooses to surrender herself to the Earth, as Luv and Kush desperately try to stop her.

videos.title: Mata Sita Ki Mahanta
videos.overview: Mata Sita breaks down in the darbar as she faces everyone. Soon, Maa Dharti appears and prepares to take her away. How will Shri Ram respond?

videos.title: Siya-Ram Ek Hain
videos.overview: Shri Ram refuses to let Mata Sita leave with Maa Dharti and confronts her. Will he be able to stop her?

videos.title: Siya-Ram Ka Sachha Prem
videos.overview: Shri Ram and Luv-Kush are devastated after Mata Sita's departure. In his grief, Shri Ram vows to take a harsh step, but Lord Shiva and Brahma Dev intervene. Will they be able to calm Shri Ram?

videos.title: Shri Ram Ka Parichay
videos.overview: Lord Shiva helps Shri Ram realize his true purpose, while Luv and Kush long for their mother. Later, they are entrusted with their responsibilities

videos.title: Raghukul Ki Parampara
videos.overview: Luv and Kush seek Shri Ram's blessings as he presents three paths for the children to complete their education. Determined to learn through experience, they embark on their journey and arrive at a village.

videos.title: Maharaj Harishchandra Ka Tyaag
videos.overview: Luv and Kush narrate the story of Raja Harishchandra to persuade the villagers to respect women. Meanwhile, a Rishi arrives in Ayodhya with a ring and requests to meet with Shri Ram.

videos.title: Kaal Ka Chakra
videos.overview: Shri Ram meets the Rishi in private while Lakshman stands guard to ensure no one interrupts. Meanwhile, Luv and Kush urge the villagers to speak out against injustice.

videos.title: Aatma Samarpan Ya Mrityu
videos.overview: Luv and Kush attempt to rescue the baby from the tribe, while Shri Ram converses with Yama. Meanwhile, Rishi Durvasa arrives, but Lakshman stands in his way.

videos.title: Mrityu Dand
videos.overview: Rishi Durvasa meets Shri Ram, after which Shri Ram confronts Lakshman, who accepts the Mrityu Dand.

videos.title: Kaal Ki Chaaya
videos.overview: Luv and Kush stumble upon skeletons in a village and find themselves trapped in a swamp. Meanwhile, Lakshman urges Lord Hanuman to persuade Shri Ram to grant him 'Mrityu Dand'.

videos.title: Ahankar Aur Bahubal
videos.overview: Luv and Kush discover a way to defeat Ashtbahu, while Lord Hanuman creates his Pratibimb to safeguard Ayodhya and Shri Ram. Meanwhile, Sheshnag arrives to meet Shri Ram.

videos.title: Raj Anuj Lakshman Ki Jal Samadhi
videos.overview: Shri Ram grants Raj Anuj Lakshman permission to take the Jal Samadhi. Later, Lakshman addresses the people of Ayodhya.

videos.title: Vish Ka Prakop
videos.overview: Luv and Kush recount the tale of King Bhagirath, who sought Lord Shiva's blessings to bring the River Ganga to Earth. Can they find a way to cleanse the village of the poison?

videos.title: Luv Aur Kush Ka Tap
videos.overview: Luv and Kush pray to Lord Shiva for guidance but find themselves swallowed by a snake. Meanwhile, Shri Ram comforts a heartbroken Bharat as he grieves for Lakshman.

videos.title: Kaushal Rajya
videos.overview: Nagraj Vasuki meets Luv and Kush, guiding them to resolve the village crisis. Later, Kush takes an oath as the village king.

videos.title: Dharm Aur Vachan Ka Uddharan
videos.overview: Luv-Kush and Lord Hanuman learn about Lakshman's Samadhi. Later, they receive a warning about Kumbhakarana's son.

videos.title: Narayan Ke Naye Avatar Ki Leela
videos.overview: Bharat overcomes challenges on his journey, while Kumbhakarana's son prepares for vengeance.

videos.title: Putro Ka Sanghaar
videos.overview: Dev Rishi confronts Devamit in his darbar while Shri Ram prays for Bharat's safety. Later, Devamit's men trap Luv and Kush.

videos.title: Sankat Ka Nivaran
videos.overview: Lord Hanuman seeks out Narad Muni for answers, while Shri Ram arrives in Ayodhya and faces Brahma Dev's questions about Hanuman.

videos.title: Pratishod Ki Jwala
videos.overview: Luv and Kush are captured by Debamit's army. Meanwhile, Lord Hanuman battles Kal Purush's forces to prevent them from taking Shri Ram.

videos.title: Shri Ram Ki Raksha
videos.overview: Lord Hanuman stands firm against Yamdev and his army. Meanwhile, Luv and Kush suffer injuries while battling Debamit. How will they overcome him?

videos.title: Shri Ram Ka Shubh Chintak
videos.overview: Shri Ram sends Lord Hanuman to Patal Lok to retrieve his ring. Meanwhile, Brahma Dev grants Yamdev permission to enter Ayodhya and take Shri Ram. Will Hanuman allow this to happen in his absence?

videos.title: Deh Tyaagne Ka Nirne
videos.overview: Luv and Kush learn of Shri Ram's decision to leave his mortal form, while Lord Hanuman searches for his ring. Later, Luv and Kush confront Shri Ram about his choice.

videos.title: Niyati Ka Chakravyuh
videos.overview: Luv and Kush resolve to stop Shri Ram from leaving his mortal form. Meanwhile, Lord Hanuman faces an attack from the Naags. Later, Luv and Kush deliver a powerful message to Yamdev.

videos.title: Raghukul Ke Vanshaj Ka Margdarshan
videos.overview: Lord Hanuman encounters Nagraj Vasuki, while Brahma Dev instructs Rishi Vashisht to confront Luv and Kush. Later, Shri Ram shares a meal with his sons.

videos.title: Raja Ka Antim Daitva
videos.overview: Shri Ram addresses the people of Ayodhya and entrusts Bharat with his duties. Meanwhile, Lord Hanuman grows furious with Nagraj Vasuki.

videos.title: Shri Ram Ki Leela
videos.overview: Lord Hanuman takes Shri Ram's blessings and bids him farewell. Meanwhile, Shri Ram instructs Rishi Vashisht to arrange a yagya before his departure. Later, the Gods prepare for Shri Ram's arrival.
